build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with seed range and search params
build_task_scene: build a physics puzzle scene with slope, container, ball, table, and strut objects
add_convex_polygon: add a convex polygon body to the PHYRE scene using C.add_convex_polygon with vertices
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball object to the PHYRE scene using C.add with radius and position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task goal by setting spatial relationships like TOUCHING between bodies
